assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a premium painterly fantasy mobile game, exactly two equal square cells side by side on a 2:1 canvas. Reference attached screenshot is STYLE and OBJECT reference only. LEFT CELL: the detailed brass-and-gold magical energy cannon from the ARSENAL button, pointing right, glowing golden muzzle ring, engraved barrel, blue glass energy chamber, small restrained sparks. RIGHT CELL: the UPGRADES emblem, three intricate interlocking warm gold/brass gears, largest upper-left, secondary upper-right, small front gear, blue metal center and bevel highlights. Render objects ONLY, absolutely no button frames, text, background, checkerboard, labels or extra objects. Genuine transparent alpha background. Each object isolated centered within its half with 12% clear margins on all sides, no overlap between cells. Match polished rich warm gold and engraved surface detail of reference, strong silhouette visible at 110px. Crisp premium hand-painted game inventory art, perspective depth, not flat line icons. 1536x768.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG character sprite atlas for War of Words, a premium painterly fantasy game for adults. Exactly 12 DIFFERENT full-body opponents in a strict 4 columns x 3 rows grid on a 4:3 canvas, every cell same size. NO text, NO cell borders, NO labels, NO scenery, NO ground shadows. Real transparent alpha background. Each figure centered in its cell, feet at 90% cell height, head around 17% cell height, margins minimum 12%, no overlaps. All in three-quarter side combat stance FACING LEFT towards a hero offscreen left, hands/weapons aimed left, full bodies entirely visible. Detailed hand-painted stylized realism, warm sunlight, brass craftsmanship and vivid magical energy, mature proportions, ornate material texture, no chibi/cartoon. Row1 left to right: 1 Training Sentinel: modest ivory stone training mannequin automaton with round blue eye and padded brass fists; 2 Copper Scout: slim copper clockwork rogue with teal scarf, narrow angular head and wrist crossbow; 3 Gatekeeper: broad moss-covered stone guardian with rectangular tower shield and cyan rune face; 4 Bronze Warden: massive bronze armored champion with bull-horn helmet, red cloak and heavy gold gauntlet. Row2: 5 Sky Watcher: sleek white and skyblue avian humanoid automaton with feather-shaped shoulder blades, bird helmet and aether bow; 6 Storm Sentinel: crystalline cobalt and silver elemental humanoid with lightning core, jagged shoulders and charged left hand; 7 Bridge Guardian: tall rugged iron sentinel with giant stone shoulder plates, chain belt and sapphire hammer; 8 Tempest Warden: regal silver storm knight with swept crown, navy cape and teal lightning spear. Row3: 9 Astral Sentinel: dark indigo celestial armor with star-speckled cloth, crescent helmet and violet orb gauntlet; 10 Archive Keeper: elegant hooded burgundy and parchment scholar automaton with visible brass face and floating rune book; 11 Sunforged Elite: radiant polished gold lion-helmet knight with orange cloth and sunfire cannon forearm; 12 The Last Warden: imposing black obsidian and bright gold armored emperor with branching gold crown, white cloak, luminous turquoise chest crystal and imposing energy blade. Clearly different silhouettes, faces, outfits, weapons and palettes. Character faces all stay near horizontal center of each cell for portrait crop. Render one cohesive professional character atlas, 2048x1536.
assets.fit_edit: Edit this exact 12-character atlas for safe use as separate game sprites. Preserve all 12 identities, colors, art style and full-body poses. Crucial correction: arrange into a STRICT four equal columns and three equal rows. Scale each complete character and all its equipment/effects DOWN inside its own cell so there is at least 10% fully transparent blank space at EVERY edge of EVERY cell. No pixels may cross into another cell. Use consistent empty gutters separating all cells; no cut-off weapons, capes or feet. Place feet at 88% of each cell height, heads around 17-22%, centered face horizontally where possible. Full transparent alpha background, no grids/checkerboard/text. Keep exactly same order: training mannequin,copper scout,stone gatekeeper,bronze warden / avian watcher,blue crystal sentinel,iron bridge guardian,silver tempest warden / indigo astral sentinel,burgundy archive keeper,gold sunforged knight,black gold last warden. Output 4:3 landscape atlas. Do not change their personalities or designs; only fit sprites safely within equal cells with clear gutters.
